category.label: AI tool mention
category.description: Names of AI coding tools, or the agent narrating its own process instead of the change.

source: Group G research: anthropics/claude-code#1296 and anthropics/claude-code#66602
notes: A tool name reports only next to process wording (`generated by`, `written by`, `suggested by`) or inside a `git commit` command, so a comment that just names a tool stays clean. That wording around `the model` or `the assistant` reports as well, which a repo whose subject is model output drops with `disablePatterns`.

patterns.show: `generated by` or `written with` a named AI tool

patterns.regex: \bgit\s+commit\b[\s\S]{0,400}?(?<hit>\b(?:Claude Code|OpenAI Codex|Codex CLI|GitHub Copilot|Cursor Agent|Gemini CLI|ChatGPT|GPT-[45](?:\.\d)?)\b)
patterns.show: a `git commit` command naming an AI tool
